pool.text: The church was constructed before being destroyed in a later conflict.
The previously built church was completely destroyed during this year.
King Gustavus Adolphus established the trading colony by royal charter.
Successful establishment of the city occurred under King Gustavus Adolphus.
The city received its official names in its charter document.
Swedes gained political control after the last Dutch politician died.
Territories were ceded by Denmark-Norway leaving the city less exposed.
The Swedish East India Company was established to drive foreign trade.
Decisions were finalized to tear down most of the city wall.
Feskekörkan opened its doors, earning a name resembling a Gothic church.
Volvo was established in the city, maintaining headquarters on Hisingen island.
Rya Skogs Naturreservat was officially designated as a protected natural area.
Uno Åhrén began his tenure serving the municipality as city planner.
Flunsåsparken was constructed to offer free summer activities like concerts.
Ullevi stadium was constructed when Sweden hosted the FIFA World Cup.
The film festival started holding annual January events to attract visitors.
An agreement was signed with Shanghai to foster international cooperation.
The International Science Festival launched annual science activities for the public.
Universeum opened as a public science centre in Scandinavia.
The city promoted its specific name internationally before reversing it later.
